title: Monte Carlo Physics-informed Neural Networks for Inverse Multiscale Heat Conduction Problems via the Phonon Boltzmann Transport Equation
summary: Inferring thermal fields and thermophysical properties from limited measurements is a fundamental challenge in micro- and nanoscale heat conduction, where the classical Fourier law breaks down and the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) is needed to capture non-diffusive transport effects. In this work, we extend Monte Carlo physics-informed neural networks (MC-PINNs), originally developed for forward phonon BTE problems [J. Comput. Phys. 542, 114364, 2025], to inverse multiscale heat conduction problems. Two representative classes of inverse problems are considered: (i) reconstructing…
